title: POST /api/projects/:id/parking-lot/:pid/ai-pathway — generate AI pathway for parking lot item
description: Generate a step-by-step AI pathway for implementing a parking lot idea. Saves the result to the item's ai_pathway field.
acceptanceCriteria: POST requires auth and project ownership
Returns 400 if user has no AI API key
Calls AI with item title + description + project context

steps.description: Implement POST /:pid/ai-pathway in parking lot router
steps.details: 1) getOwnedProject. 2) Fetch user — check ai_api_key. 3) Find parking lot item. 4) Build prompt: 'Generate a step-by-step implementation pathway for this idea: TITLE. Description: DESCRIPTION. Project context: CONTEXT. Return a numbered list of clear, actionable steps.' 5) Call AI (same pattern as TASK-75). 6) Update item.ai_pathway = response. 7) Return 200 { pathway }.
Create a parking lot item with title 'Add dark mode'. Call ai-pathway. Verify ai_pathway is set on the item and response is a numbered list.
